title: Monday, July 27, 2026
description: Three things for the desk: mortgage rates hit a one-year high at roughly 6.75% with the Fed meeting Wednesday and the market pricing a hike rather than a cut; New Jersey is splitting by product type, with Essex single-family selling at 112% of list in 23 days while Hudson County condos sit at 42 days; and Fannie and Freddie eliminate limited condo reviews on August 3rd, adding an estimated $1,000+ per loan. Also today: New York State median price set a record at $475,000, Manhattan rents hit a record $5,295, landlords sued the NYC Rent Guidelines Board over the Mamdani rent freeze, US-Iran strikes paused for a second day, 300,000+ evacuated in French and Spanish wildfires, and Mourinho opened his second Real Madrid spell with a 1-0 win.
